title: 4 Days Fly-In to Northern Serengeti Safari
description: This 4 days fly-in safari is ideal for travelers who want to experience Tanzania’s top wildlife destinations in a short time while avoiding long road transfers. The 4 days fly-in safari begins with a scenic flight from Zanzibar or Arusha to the Northern Serengeti, a remote area famous for the Great Migration and thrilling Mara River crossings, offering outstanding game viewing in a pristine wilderness setting.

Continuing the journey, the 4 days fly-in safari explores the wildlife-rich Central Serengeti, known for its vast plains and high concentration of predators, before descending into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater. This 4 days fly-in safari concludes in Arusha, delivering an unforgettable combination of iconic landscapes, abundant wildlife, and seamless travel designed for comfort and efficiency.
highlights: Fly-in safari from Zanzibar or Arusha
Explore the Northern Serengeti, famous for the Great Migration
Chance to witness Mara River crossings (seasonal)
Exceptional predator sightings in Serengeti National Park
Ngorongoro Crater game drive (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
Opportunity to see the Big Five, including the black rhino
Private 4×4 safari vehicle with a professional guide
Perfect short safari with maximum wildlife experience
includes: All transport in a 4x4 safari vehicle
excludes: Optional activities (e.g. hot air balloon safari )

itinerary.title: Fly from Zanzibar or Arusha to Northern Serengeti
itinerary.text: After a scenic flight, arrive in the Northern Serengeti and begin your game drive immediately upon landing. The afternoon is spent exploring the open plains and Mara River area, home to elephants, buffaloes, zebras, giraffes, and predators such as lions, leopards, and cheetahs. From July to October, this region offers exceptional opportunities to witness the Great Wildebeest Migration and dramatic river crossings.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti to Central Serengeti
itinerary.text: Start the day with an early morning game drive, the best time to spot predators at their most active. After breakfast, continue with an en-route game drive toward Central Serengeti, enjoying continuous wildlife sightings across vast plains. In the Seronera area, game drives focus on rivers and kopjes, which attract lion prides, cheetahs, elephants, hippos, and abundant birdlife.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti to Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.text: After breakfast, enjoy a morning game drive in Central Serengeti, exploring predator-rich areas and open grasslands. Later, depart Serengeti for the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. As you ascend into the Ngorongoro Highlands, the scenery transforms into lush green hills with beautiful panoramic views. Overnight near the crater or in the highlands.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive – Return to Arusha
itinerary.text: Following an early breakfast, descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a half-day game drive in one of Africa’s most wildlife-dense ecosystems. Expect sightings of lions, buffaloes, elephants, hippos, flamingos, and the rare black rhino. After a picnic lunch inside the crater, ascend and drive back to Arusha, marking the end of an unforgettable safari.

summary: This 4 days fly-in safari is ideal for travelers who want to experience Tanzania’s top wildlife destinations in a short time while avoiding long road transfers.
